Analysis of the EcoPart particle distribution data. This updates the UVP_POC_Flux_Calculations.Rmd for work specifically on the UVP6. It includes the calculation of the POC flux based on the detailed 45* size classes and evaluations of the sample distribution and particle size distributions.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


# Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggOceanMaps) 

theme_set(theme_bw())
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

source("functions/uvp_poc_flux_functions.R")
load("data/UVP6_ECOPART_Data_20251121.RData")

# Annotate metadata
uvp6_profiles <- uvp6_profiles %>% 
  rename(datetime = `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm`) %>%
  mutate(year = year(datetime), month = month(datetime), doy = yday(datetime))
```

```{r}
                          color = Site)) +
```

## Calculate POC flux for a single profile
```{r, eval=FALSE}
sc.df <- uvp6_par_cnames %>% 
  filter(grepl("concentration", AnnotatedColumnName) == T) %>% 
  filter(Lower_limit_um >= 50.80) %>% 
  filter(Size_class_midpoint_mm > 0.073)

# Get width of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_width <- sc.df$Size_class_width_mm
# Get midpoints of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_mid <- sc.df$Size_class_midpoint_mm

# TODO Exclude size classes below ... 128 um?
# Seems like SC 18 and 19 (50.8-64 and 64-80.6 um) have anomalously high counts and note that these are below the UVP6 resolution of 0.73 um pixel-1, so could not be trusted.
# Excluding SC 20 and 21 ( 80.6-128 um) does not seem to change the POC flux calculation that much since their particle concentrations seem reasonable


# For each row apply the calculations
# TODO should the 32-128 um size classes be removed to match UVP5 measurements?
pocFlux <- A %>% 
  select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  mutate(ObsFlux = NA, ModelFlux = NA, C1 = NA, alpha = NA, lambda = NA)

# TODO generalize later to just do the entire ecopart df with all stations
for (i in c(1:nrow(pocFlux))) {
  a_par <- A[i, 10:35]
  a_vol <- A$Sampled_volume_L[i]
  
  # No model
  pocFlux$ObsFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(a_par, UVP6_sizebins_mid)
  # With truncated power law model
  observedN <- round( a_par * a_vol )
  
  
  if(sum(observedN) > 0){
    tryCatch( {
      trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN, a_vol, 
                                    UVP6_sizebins_width, UVP6_sizebins_mid )
      
      pocFlux$ModelFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(trunc$estimNbl, UVP6_sizebins_mid)
      pocFlux$C1[i] <- trunc$C1
      pocFlux$alpha[i] <- trunc$alpha
      pocFlux$lambda[i] <- trunc$lambda
    },
    error = function(e){cat("ERROR: at i =", i, " ", 
                            conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
    
    # Start at 128 um size class?
    a_par128 <- a_par
    a_par128[1:2] <- 0
    
    tryCatch( {
      pocFlux$ObsFlux128[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(a_par128, UVP6_sizebins_mid)
      observedN <- round( a_par128 * a_vol )
      trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN, a_vol, 
                                    UVP6_sizebins_width, UVP6_sizebins_mid )
      pocFlux$ModelFlux128[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(trunc$estimNbl, UVP6_sizebins_mid)
    },
    error = function(e){cat("ERROR: at i =", i, " ", 
                            conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
    
  } 
  
  # Add the random samples function for sample volume error
  simulatedNbl <- generateRandomSamplesOfParticleNumber(a_par, a_vol)
  fluxIter <- rep(NA, nIterations)
  for (iIter in seq_len(nIterations)) {
    if (sum(simulatedNbl[iIter, ], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      fluxIter[iIter] <- calculatePOCFlux(simulatedNbl[iIter, ], UVP6_sizebins_mid)
    }
  }
  pocFlux$fluxErr[i] <- sd(fluxIter, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  
  simulatedNbl <- generateRandomSamplesOfParticleNumber(a_par128, a_vol)
  fluxIter <- rep(NA, nIterations)
  for (iIter in seq_len(nIterations)) {
    if (sum(simulatedNbl[iIter, ], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      fluxIter[iIter] <- calculatePOCFlux(simulatedNbl[iIter, ], UVP6_sizebins_mid)
    }
  }
  pocFlux$fluxErr128[i] <- sd(fluxIter, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Observed vs modelled flux
cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(pocFlux, aes(x = ObsFlux, y = Depth_5m)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_point(aes(x = ModelFlux), color = "blue") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ModelFlux - fluxErr, 
                      xmax = ModelFlux + fluxErr), width = 0, color = "blue") +
    scale_y_reverse(),
  
  ggplot(pocFlux, aes(y = Depth_5m)) +
    geom_point(aes(x = ModelFlux128), color = "deepskyblue") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ModelFlux128 - fluxErr128, 
                      xmax = ModelFlux128 + fluxErr128), 
                  width = 0, color = "deepskyblue") +
    geom_point(aes(x = ObsFlux128), color = "pink") +
    scale_y_reverse() 
)

# The Modelled POC flux + error bar
ggplot(pocFlux, aes(x = ModelFlux, y = Depth_5m)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ModelFlux - fluxErr, 
                    xmax = ModelFlux + fluxErr), width = 0, color = "blue") +
  scale_y_reverse()




```




# Calculate flux for 128 um to 26mm (23 size classes)

## Preparations
```{r}
sc.df <- uvp6_par_cnames %>% 
  filter(grepl("concentration", AnnotatedColumnName) == T) %>% 
  filter(Lower_limit_um >= 128) %>% 
  filter(Lower_limit_um < 26000)
# Get width of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_width <- sc.df$Size_class_width_mm
# Get midpoints of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_mid <- sc.df$Size_class_midpoint_mm

print(paste0("N size classes: ",length(UVP6_sizebins_mid)))
```


## TODO: Apply to all profiles, average by depth bin
```{r}
# TODO fix issue with the optimization model when the C1 value needs to be changed
nIterations <-  100
pocFlux <- uvp6_PAR %>% 
  select(sample_id, date, time, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  mutate(ObsFlux = NA, ModelFlux = NA, C1 = NA, alpha = NA, lambda = NA,
         fluxErr = NA)

for (i in c(1:nrow(pocFlux))) {
  a_par <- uvp6_PAR[i, (36-length(UVP6_sizebins_mid)):35]
  a_vol <- uvp6_PAR$Sampled_volume_L[i]
  
  # No model
  pocFlux$ObsFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(a_par, UVP6_sizebins_mid)
  # With truncated power law model
  observedN <- round( a_par * a_vol )
  
  tryCatch( {
    trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN, a_vol, 
                                  UVP6_sizebins_width, UVP6_sizebins_mid )
    
    pocFlux$ModelFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(trunc$estimNbl, UVP6_sizebins_mid)
    pocFlux$C1[i] <- trunc$C1
    pocFlux$alpha[i] <- trunc$alpha
    pocFlux$lambda[i] <- trunc$lambda
  },
  error = function(e){cat("ERROR: at i =", i, " ", 
                          conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
  
  # Add the random samples function for sample volume error
  simulatedNbl <- generateRandomSamplesOfParticleNumber(a_par, a_vol,
                                                        N_sizebins = length(UVP6_sizebins_mid))
  fluxIter <- rep(NA, nIterations)
  for (iIter in seq_len(nIterations)) {
    if (sum(simulatedNbl[iIter, ], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      fluxIter[iIter] <- calculatePOCFlux(simulatedNbl[iIter, ], UVP6_sizebins_mid)
    }
  }
  pocFlux$fluxErr[i] <- sd(fluxIter, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  
  if (i%%500 == 0) {
    print(paste("Finished processing:",i,"rows."))
  }
}

save(file = paste0("data/pocFlux_estimates_23sc_", 
                   format(Sys.time(), "%Y %m %d"),
                   ".RData"),
  pocFlux, sc.df)
```

# ** REDUCED PAR ** 
## Read data
```{r}
# Load the file of reduced Particle concentrations for all profiles
cnames <- read.csv('data/Ecopart_PAR_file_column_names_reduced.csv')

filename <- "all_legs_reduced_84960/export_reduced_20251210_21_24_PAR_Aggregated"
uvp6_reduced <- read.table(paste0("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/Ecopart/", filename, ".tsv"),  
                    header = FALSE, skip = 1) %>% 
# Remove column 4 because it is time only 
  select(-V4)
colnames(uvp6_reduced) <- cnames$AnnotatedColumnName

# Note volume is per liter
uvp6_reduced <- uvp6_reduced %>%
  select(c(sample_id:Sampled_volume_L,
           concentration_128_256_um:concentration_16_mm))

# Establish size bins
UVP6_sizebins_edges_um <- c(128,256,512,1024,2048,4096,8192,16384,32768)
UVP6_N_sizebins <- 8
# Convert um to mm
UVP6_sizebins_edges_mm <- UVP6_sizebins_edges_um * 0.001
# Get width of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_width <- UVP6_sizebins_edges_mm[1:8]
# Get midpoints of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_mid <- UVP6_sizebins_edges_mm[1:8] + UVP6_sizebins_width/2 
```

## Calculate flux
```{r}
nIterations <- 100 
pocFlux_UVP6 <- uvp6_reduced %>% 
  select(sample_id, project, datetime, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  mutate(ObsFlux = NA, ModelFlux = NA, C1 = NA, alpha = NA, lambda = NA,
         fluxErr = NA)

for (i in c(1:nrow(pocFlux_UVP6))) { #c(1:20)) { #
  a_par <- uvp6_reduced[i, 7:14]
  a_vol <- uvp6_reduced$Sampled_volume_L[i]
  
  # No model
  pocFlux_UVP6$ObsFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(a_par, UVP6_sizebins_mid)
  # With truncated power law model
  observedN <- round( a_par * a_vol )
  
  if(sum(observedN) > 0){
    tryCatch( {
      trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN, a_vol, 
                                    UVP6_sizebins_width, UVP6_sizebins_mid )
      
      pocFlux_UVP6$ModelFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(trunc$estimNbl,
                                                    UVP6_sizebins_mid)
      pocFlux_UVP6$C1[i] <- trunc$C1
      pocFlux_UVP6$alpha[i] <- trunc$alpha
      pocFlux_UVP6$lambda[i] <- trunc$lambda
    },
    error = function(e){cat("ERROR: at i =", i, " ", 
                            conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
  } 

  # Add the random samples function for sample volume error
  simulatedNbl <- generateRandomSamplesOfParticleNumber(a_par, a_vol,
                                                        N_sizebins = UVP6_N_sizebins)
  fluxIter <- rep(NA, nIterations)
  for (iIter in seq_len(nIterations)) {
    if (sum(simulatedNbl[iIter, ], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      fluxIter[iIter] <- calculatePOCFlux(simulatedNbl[iIter, ], UVP6_sizebins_mid)
    }
  }
  pocFlux_UVP6$fluxErr[i] <- sd(fluxIter, na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

## Analyze flux per region
```{r}
# Annual integration to gC m-2 y-1 from mg C m-2 d-1
poc_flux_annual <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(poc_model = (ModelFlux * 123 / 1000) + (ModelFlux/4 * 242 / 1000),
         poc_error = (fluxErr * 123 / 1000) + (fluxErr/4 * 242 / 1000)) 


# POC flux, get flux at reference_depth +- 10 m average
# values in mg C m-2 d-1
reference_depth <- 500
poc_flux_annual_500 <- poc_flux_annual %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= (reference_depth-10) & Depth_5m <= (reference_depth+10)) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, project) %>% 
  summarise(poc_model = mean(poc_model, na.rm = T),
            poc_error = mean(poc_error, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(poc_model < 500)

# Group by
```
